queries.name: gate1a_empresas_canonicas_activas
queries.sql:
SELECT
    e.EmpresaID,
    CONCAT('EmpresaID=', CAST(e.EmpresaID AS VARCHAR(20))) AS EmpresaNombre,
    e.Activo
FROM dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
WHERE ISNULL(e.Activo, 0) = 1
ORDER BY e.EmpresaID

queries.name: gate1a_reactivate_existing_candidates
queries.sql:
WITH active_users AS (
    SELECT
        u.UsuarioID,
        u.Email,
        u.Username,
        u.NombreCompleto,
        MAX(ISNULL(r.NivelJerarquia, 0)) AS MaxRolNivelActivo,
        MAX(CASE WHEN r.CodigoRol IN ('SUPERADMIN','ADMIN') OR ISNULL(r.NivelJerarquia,0) >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EsAdminOSuperAdmin
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion ra
      ON ra.UsuarioID = u.UsuarioID
     AND ISNULL(ra.Activo, 0) = 1
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
      ON r.RolID = ra.RolID
     AND ISNULL(r.Activo, 0) = 1
    WHERE ISNULL(u.Activo, 0) = 1
    GROUP BY
        u.UsuarioID,
        u.Email,
        u.Username,
        u.NombreCompleto
)
SELECT
    au.UsuarioID,
    au.Email,
    au.Username,
    au.NombreCompleto,
    au.MaxRolNivelActivo,
    au.EsAdminOSuperAdmin,
    ea.EmpresaID,
    CONCAT('EmpresaID=', CAST(ea.EmpresaID AS VARCHAR(20))) AS EmpresaNombre,
    ea.EsPrincipal,
    ea.Activo AS AsignacionActivaActual,
    CASE
        WHEN au.EsAdminOSuperAdmin = 1 THEN 'REACTIVATE_EXISTING_ADMIN_SCOPE'
        ELSE 'REACTIVATE_EXISTING_BUSINESS_SCOPE'
    END AS AccionPropuesta,
    'EXISTING_ROW_INACTIVE_VALID_EMPRESA' AS Motivo,
    CONCAT('BACKUP UsuarioID=', au.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', ea.EmpresaID) AS BackupRequerido,
    CONCAT('ROLLBACK deactivate UsuarioID=', au.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', ea.EmpresaID) AS RollbackTexto
FROM active_users au
JOIN dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ea
  ON ea.UsuarioID = au.UsuarioID
JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
  ON e.EmpresaID = ea.EmpresaID
WHERE ISNULL(ea.Activo, 0) = 0
  AND ISNULL(e.Activo, 0) = 1
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ea2
      WHERE ea2.UsuarioID = au.UsuarioID
        AND ISNULL(ea2.Activo, 0) = 1
  )
ORDER BY au.EsAdminOSuperAdmin DESC, au.UsuarioID, ea.EmpresaID

queries.name: gate1a_add_missing_admin_scope_candidates
queries.sql:
WITH admin_users AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        u.UsuarioID,
        u.Email,
        u.Username,
        u.NombreCompleto,
        r.CodigoRol,
        r.NivelJerarquia
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u
    JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion ra
      ON ra.UsuarioID = u.UsuarioID
     AND ISNULL(ra.Activo, 0) = 1
    JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
      ON r.RolID = ra.RolID
     AND ISNULL(r.Activo, 0) = 1
    WHERE ISNULL(u.Activo, 0) = 1
      AND (
            r.CodigoRol IN ('SUPERADMIN', 'ADMIN')
            OR ISNULL(r.NivelJerarquia, 0) >= 90
          )
),
missing_admin AS (
    SELECT au.*
    FROM admin_users au
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ea
        WHERE ea.UsuarioID = au.UsuarioID
    )
),
active_empresas AS (
    SELECT
        e.EmpresaID,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY e.EmpresaID) AS rn
    FROM dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
    WHERE ISNULL(e.Activo, 0) = 1
)
SELECT
    ma.UsuarioID,
    ma.Email,
    ma.Username,
    ma.NombreCompleto,
    ma.CodigoRol,
    ma.NivelJerarquia,
    ae.EmpresaID,
    CONCAT('EmpresaID=', CAST(ae.EmpresaID AS VARCHAR(20))) AS EmpresaNombre,
    CASE WHEN ae.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS EsPrincipalPropuesto,
    'ADD_MISSING_ADMIN_SCOPE' AS AccionPropuesta,
    'ADMIN_OR_SUPERADMIN_WITH_ZERO_EMPRESA_ROWS' AS Motivo,
    CONCAT('BACKUP missing row UsuarioID=', ma.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', ae.EmpresaID) AS BackupRequerido,
    CONCAT('ROLLBACK deactivate created row UsuarioID=', ma.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', ae.EmpresaID) AS RollbackTexto
FROM missing_admin ma
CROSS JOIN active_empresas ae
ORDER BY ma.UsuarioID, ae.EmpresaID

queries.name: gate1a_business_scope_derivation_candidates
queries.sql:
WITH active_users AS (
    SELECT
        u.UsuarioID,
        u.Email,
        u.Username,
        u.NombreCompleto,
        MAX(ISNULL(r.NivelJerarquia, 0)) AS MaxRolNivelActivo
    FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo u
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion ra
      ON ra.UsuarioID = u.UsuarioID
     AND ISNULL(ra.Activo, 0) = 1
    LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles r
      ON r.RolID = ra.RolID
     AND ISNULL(r.Activo, 0) = 1
    WHERE ISNULL(u.Activo, 0) = 1
    GROUP BY
        u.UsuarioID,
        u.Email,
        u.Username,
        u.NombreCompleto
),
business_users AS (
    SELECT au.*
    FROM active_users au
    WHERE ISNULL(au.MaxRolNivelActivo, 0) < 90
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ea
          WHERE ea.UsuarioID = au.UsuarioID
            AND ISNULL(ea.Activo, 0) = 1
      )
),
scope_raw AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        usa.UsuarioID,
        s.EmpresaID,
        'SERVIDOR_MAP' AS FuenteDecision
    FROM dbo.Usuario_ServidoresAsignacion usa
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo m
      ON CAST(m.ServidorID AS VARCHAR(50)) = CAST(usa.ServidorID AS VARCHAR(50))
     AND ISNULL(m.Activo, 0) = 1
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_Sucursales s
      ON s.SucursalID = m.SucursalID
     AND ISNULL(s.Activo, 0) = 1
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
      ON e.EmpresaID = s.EmpresaID
     AND ISNULL(e.Activo, 0) = 1
    WHERE ISNULL(usa.Activo, 0) = 1

    UNION

    SELECT DISTINCT
        us.UsuarioID,
        s.EmpresaID,
        'SUCURSAL_SERVER_MAP' AS FuenteDecision
    FROM dbo.Usuario_SucursalesAsignacion us
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_SucursalServidorMapeo m
      ON CAST(m.ServidorID AS VARCHAR(50)) = CAST(us.ServidorID AS VARCHAR(50))
     AND ISNULL(m.Activo, 0) = 1
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_Sucursales s
      ON s.SucursalID = m.SucursalID
     AND ISNULL(s.Activo, 0) = 1
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_Empresas e
      ON e.EmpresaID = s.EmpresaID
     AND ISNULL(e.Activo, 0) = 1
    WHERE ISNULL(us.Activo, 0) = 1
),
scope_counts AS (
    SELECT
        UsuarioID,
        COUNT(DISTINCT EmpresaID) AS EmpresasDerivadas
    FROM scope_raw
    GROUP BY UsuarioID
)
SELECT
    bu.UsuarioID,
    bu.Email,
    bu.Username,
    bu.NombreCompleto,
    bu.MaxRolNivelActivo,
    sr.EmpresaID,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.EmpresaID IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CONCAT('EmpresaID=', CAST(sr.EmpresaID AS VARCHAR(20)))
    END AS EmpresaNombre,
    sr.FuenteDecision,
    ISNULL(sc.EmpresasDerivadas, 0) AS EmpresasDerivadas,
    CASE
        WHEN sc.EmpresasDerivadas IS NULL THEN 'MANUAL_SCOPE_REQUIRED'
        WHEN sc.EmpresasDerivadas > 1 THEN 'MANUAL_SCOPE_REQUIRED_AMBIGUOUS'
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion ea
            WHERE ea.UsuarioID = bu.UsuarioID
              AND ea.EmpresaID = sr.EmpresaID
              AND ISNULL(ea.Activo, 0) = 0
        ) THEN 'REACTIVATE_EXISTING_DERIVED_SCOPE'
        ELSE 'ADD_MISSING_DERIVED_SCOPE'
    END AS AccionPropuesta,
    CASE
        WHEN sc.EmpresasDerivadas IS NULL THEN 'NO_CANONICAL_SCOPE_FROM_SERVER_OR_SUCURSAL'
        WHEN sc.EmpresasDerivadas > 1 THEN 'MULTIPLE_EMPRESAS_DERIVED_REQUIRES_HUMAN_DECISION'
        ELSE 'SINGLE_EMPRESA_DERIVED_FROM_OPERATIONAL_SCOPE'
    END AS Motivo,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.EmpresaID IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE CONCAT('BACKUP UsuarioID=', bu.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', sr.EmpresaID)
    END AS BackupRequerido,
    CASE
        WHEN sr.EmpresaID IS NULL OR sc.EmpresasDerivadas <> 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE CONCAT('ROLLBACK deactivate UsuarioID=', bu.UsuarioID, ' EmpresaID=', sr.EmpresaID)
    END AS RollbackTexto
FROM business_users bu
LEFT JOIN scope_counts sc
  ON sc.UsuarioID = bu.UsuarioID
LEFT JOIN scope_raw sr
  ON sr.UsuarioID = bu.UsuarioID
ORDER BY bu.UsuarioID, sr.EmpresaID

queries.name: gate1a_final_decision_readonly
queries.sql:
SELECT
    'GATE1A_PLAN_ONLY' AS Decision,
    'NO_DML_EXECUTED' AS DmlStatus,
    'AUTHORIZE_GATE1B_ONLY_IF_EXACT_USUARIOID_EMPRESAID_BACKUP_ROLLBACK' AS Gate1BRule,
    'DO_NOT_REDEPLOY_BEFORE_DATA_RBAC_FIX' AS DeployRule

objective: Generar plan exacto de corrección para dbo.Usuario_EmpresasAsignacion sin ejecutar DML, DDL ni deploy. Debe producir matriz UsuarioID, Email, AccionPropuesta, EmpresaID, motivo, backup y rollback para decidir si procede Gate1B controlado.
